name: panel-search
title: Panel Search
description: The sticky, box-free search row a filtering popup puts at the top of its panel (decision OVL-11) — shared by EmojiPicker and ShortcutOverlay.

meta.whenToUse: Installed automatically with EmojiPicker or ShortcutOverlay; import it directly when building another popup that filters its own contents.
meta.whenNotToUse: A standalone search field on a page — that is Input, or InputGroup with a leading addon. A command palette is Command, which brings its own input.
